summary: Destra Multi-Alternative Fund (NYSE: DMA) filed an 8-K disclosing a board-authorized share repurchase program, an increase in monthly distributions to $0.1150 per share, and an update on its term-structure measurement period, announced October 12, 2026. Repurchases may occur when shares trade below NAV, beginning after an initial 30-day cooling-off period, with Clear Street as executing broker. No fixed price, share count, premium, or dollar authorization was stated. Board framed the actions as enhancing shareholder value and supporting market valuation. Watch the discount-to-NAV spread and actual repurchase pace as the arbitrage signal.
